rm(list=ls())

# Read in files
```{r}
megatable <- read.csv("../data/pangenome_project_megatable.csv")
consensus <- megatable[c("Donor_ID", "Reference", "Consensus_Precision", "Consensus_Recall", "Consensus_F1_Score")]
consensus$Variant_Caller <- "Consensus"
```

# Setup
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

consensus_color <- c("#5592D9")
```

# Useful functions
```{r}
rename_col <- function(df) {
  colnames(df)[grepl("_Recall$", colnames(df))] <- "Recall"
  colnames(df)[grepl("_Precision$", colnames(df))] <- "Precision"
  colnames(df)[grepl("_F1_Score$", colnames(df))] <- "F1_Score"
  return(df)
}

as_numeric <- function(df) {
  df <- df[df$Reference %in% c("Pangenome", "Linear"), ]
  df$F1_Score <- as.numeric(df$F1_Score)
  df$Precision <- as.numeric(df$Precision)
  df$Recall <- as.numeric(df$Recall)
  return(df)
}
```

# Plot template
```{r}
consensus_boxplot <- function(data, plot_title, legend_pos) {
  
  set.seed(1)
  result <- ggplot(data, aes(Metric, Value, fill=Variant_Caller)) + 
     annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = -Inf, xmax = 1.5,      
      ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,   
      alpha = 0.2,                
      fill = "grey") +
    stat_boxplot(
      geom = "errorbar", 
      width = 0.3, 
      color = "black", 
      size = 0.6) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.6, 
      outlier.shape = NA, 
      alpha = 1, 
      color = "black", 
      size = 0.6) +
    labs(
#      title = title, 
      x = element_blank(), 
      y = "Metric Percentage (%)") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
      "F1_Score" = "F1 Score",
      "Precision" = "Precision",
      "Recall" = "Recall"
    )) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(-1, 100),
      breaks = seq(-100, 100, 20)) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = consensus_color) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = "black",
      name = "Variant Caller") +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.1,
      size = 2,
      shape = 21,
      aes(color = Variant_Caller),
      fill = NA,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 22,
                                             size = 6,
                                             fill = consensus_color, 
                                             color = "black")), 
    fill  = "none") +
    theme(
      legend.position = legend_pos,
      # legend.position.inside = c(0.75, 0.07),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      # panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#F0F0F0"),
      # panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(color = "#F0F0F0"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), 
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.line.y.left   = element_line(color = "black")
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.5, y = Inf,
      label = plot_title,
      size = 6,
      color = "black",
      hjust = 0, 
      vjust = 2
    )
  
  return(result)
}
```


===============
# Pangenome
===============

# Filter only Pangenome data 
```{r}
consensus_pan <- consensus[consensus$Reference == "Pangenome", ]

consensus_pan <- rename_col(consensus_pan)
consensus_pan <- as_numeric(consensus_pan)

consensus_long_pan <- data.frame(
  Donor_ID = rep(consensus_pan$Donor_ID, times = 3),
  Variant_Caller = rep(consensus_pan$Variant_Caller, times = 3),
  Metric = rep(c("F1_Score", "Precision", "Recall"), 
               each = nrow(consensus_pan)),
  Value  = c(consensus_pan$F1_Score, 
             consensus_pan$Precision, 
             consensus_pan$Recall)
)
```

# Plot Pangenome
```{r}
set.seed(1)
consensus_pan_output <- consensus_boxplot(consensus_long_pan, "Pangenome", "none")

consensus_pan_output
```

# Save Pangenome
```{r}
# Change directory when on cluster!!!!!!
ggsave("./plot/supp3_consensus_boxplot_pangenome.pdf", plot = consensus_pan_output, width = 5, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

# Plot Linear
